changes.title: What to Know About David Crowley, the Democratic Candidate for Wisconsin Governor
changes.summary: The Milwaukee County executive, who won a tight primary race against Francesca Hong early Wednesday, could become the first Black governor of Wisconsin.

changes.title: In upset, moderate David Crowley defeats democratic socialist Francesca Hong in Wisconsin gubernatorial primary
changes.summary: David Crowley unexpectedly beat a progressive candidate in the Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor, and will face Republican Rep. Tom Tiffany on the ballot in November.

changes.title: Wisconsin primary offers mixed signals for Democrats, and other election takeaways
changes.summary: David Crowley's win by less than a percentage point over state Rep. Francesca Hong, a democratic socialist, showed neither side of the party debate was winning the argument convincingly.

changes.title: Even some progressives are happy about Hong’s loss
changes.summary: After hot DSA summer comes the fall. Democratic socialist Francesca Hong’s stunning loss in Wisconsin’s Democratic gubernatorial primary Tuesday night revealed limits to the far left’s power — and is undercutting the narrative of an emerging insurgency. While progressive Peggy Flanagan cruised by 20 points in Minnesota.

changes.title: How Crowley Eked Out a Win in the Wisconsin Governor Primary
changes.summary: A shifting race and a key endorsement helped the moderate Democrat overcome his progressive challenger, Francesca Hong, voters said.

changes.title: Hong’s Defeat in Wisconsin Shows the Limits of the Progressive Movement
changes.summary: Francesca Hong’s defeat in the Democratic primary for governor defied expectations and may have shown the democratic socialist wave cannot reach beyond urban centers.

changes.title: Why Were Polls So Wrong in the Wisconsin Governor’s Race?
changes.summary: Francesca Hong, the democratic socialist running in Wisconsin’s Democratic primary for governor, had a double-digit lead in polls as recently as last week. Then she lost. What happened?

changes.title: Areas to Watch in Wisconsin’s Democratic Primary for Governor
changes.summary: A race between Francesca Hong and David Crowley could highlight the fault lines between Madison and Milwaukee.
